user.title: NAS Hub
user.description: Which service should be added? Each one becomes its own entry and can be reconfigured later.

jellyfin.title: Jellyfin
jellyfin.description: API key: Jellyfin dashboard → API keys → +.

data_description.url: How Home Assistant reaches the server, e.g. http://nas.local:8096
data_description.public_url: Used for links in the cards, e.g. https://jellyfin.example.duckdns.org. Empty = local address.

audiobookshelf.title: Audiobookshelf
audiobookshelf.description: API key: Audiobookshelf → Settings → API keys. "Continue listening" is the progress of the key's user.

data_description.url: How Home Assistant reaches the server, e.g. http://nas.local:13378
data_description.public_url: Used for links in the cards. Empty = local address.

sonarr.title: Sonarr
sonarr.description: API key: Sonarr → Settings → General → Security.

data_description.url: How Home Assistant reaches the server, e.g. http://nas.local:8989
data_description.public_url: Used for links in the cards. Empty = local address.

radarr.title: Radarr
radarr.description: API key: Radarr → Settings → General → Security.

data_description.url: How Home Assistant reaches the server, e.g. http://nas.local:7878
data_description.public_url: Used for links in the cards. Empty = local address.

ebooks.title: E-book sending
ebooks.description: The ebook-sender container on the NAS: its web address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8095. It runs without a login, so there is no key.

data_description.url: How Home Assistant reaches the container
data_description.public_url: Used for links in the cards. Empty = local address.

reconfigure.title: Change {service}
reconfigure.description: New address or API key. The key is checked before it is saved.

reauth_confirm.title: {service}: new API key
reauth_confirm.description: {service} no longer accepts the stored API key.

seerr.title: Seerr
seerr.description: API key: Seerr → Settings → General → API Key.

data_description.url: How Home Assistant reaches the server, e.g. http://nas.local:5055
data_description.public_url: For links in cards and notifications. Empty = local address.

error.cannot_connect: The service did not answer at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The service rejected the API key.

abort.already_configured: This service is already set up at this address.

data_description.list_minutes: Newly added, upcoming, continue listening. The last answer is kept while the NAS sleeps.
data_description.live_seconds: Only asked while the NAS is awake.
data_description.availability_entity: While this entity is off/unavailable nothing is requested; when it turns on, everything is refreshed after 90 s. Empty = always ask.
data_description.show_cinema: Off: only digital and disc releases — what can be watched at home.

seerr.title: Seerr

data.min_request_days: Only requests at least this old

data_description.min_request_days: Whoever asked yesterday is still waiting for it anyway. 0 = announce every request.
data_description.availability_entity: While this entity is off/unavailable nothing is fetched. Empty = always fetch.
